packageRules.description: v10 returns its templates as functions under `writer.template`, but conventional-changelog-writer@8 - the version @semantic-release/release-notes-generator depends on - only reads Handlebars strings from `writer.mainTemplate`. The result is release notes containing nothing but the heading. Lift this once release-notes-generator ships a writer that understands v10.
